propositions: Closed bugs lacking close_class must be backfilled by inferring classification from structural signals only: revert of STATUS/COMMITS event infers regression, plan-review BLOCK verdict infers plan_defect, gate_error_v1 ERROR record infers env_integration, otherwise undetermined

Backfilled classifications must be written as separate NDJSON records to .rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified to segregate them from authoritative go-forward values
The backfill script must be idempotent: it skips any bug already present in the artifact file and any bug whose reduced state contains an authoritative close_class value
A revert signal counts as regression only if target_event_type is STATUS or COMMITS (substantive revert), not COMMENT or LINK

Plan-review BLOCK signals must be read via all_review_results API checking verdict==BLOCK, while gate_error_v1 signals require raw event-file scan of *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json files checking event[data][schema]==gate_error_v1
